comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts a robot gripper; this record tests two machine light curtains across their full fields and tags the failed unit.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses concentric rotary tools; the record carries test rods level and tip-first through multiple lanes while observing machine responses and placing a tag.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained stop angle and locking; the record checks complete field sweeps, correct failure identification/tagging, rods removed, hand clearance, and a stable dwell.
comparison.reason: Safety-field coverage testing and conditional tagging have different physical actions and outcomes from gripper-stop adjustment.
